text:
Maria: FYI seeing sustained p95/p99 SLO misses on /v1/generate (r-dense-13b) in eu-west-1 starting ~07:18 UTC. P50 ok, tails bad.
AJ: admission_queue_depth climbing, admission_latency up. Lots of tiny batches, packing rate low.
Ryan: nodes throwing "batch_evicted_no_headroom" and "max_batch_window hit" in logs.
Zhen: We lowered max_batch_window_ms in last week's tuning to tighten single-request tails. Maybe interaction with kernel rollout?
deploy-bot: runtime kernel rollout (canary) finished in eu-west-1 @ 06:45 UTC
ops-bot: alert: admission_queue_depth eu-west-1-pool > 400 (4m)
AJ: also seeing KV cache churn -> more mem pressure -> effective packing worse.
Maria: Hypothesis: smaller window + kernel changes -> less packing headroom -> admission controller starts evicting/forcing batches -> CPU/GPU overhead per-token increases -> tail latency spikes.
Ryan: Evidence: admitted_batch_sizes trending 1-4 tokens, batch_create_fail rate up, GPU_util not fully saturated.
Zhen: Quick mitigations:
- bump per_gpu_max_batch_count 32->48
- relax max_batch_window_ms 12->30
- enable soft-drop for non-critical tenants
- scale up 3-5 nodes in eu-west pool
AJ: I'll request +4 nodes now and tag them "temp-admit-headroom".
Zhen: I'll push admission-config change first to avoid unnecessary capacity churn.
Zhen: (admission config applied)
```
admission:
  per_gpu_max_batch_count: "48"
  max_batch_window_ms: "30"
  soft_drop_low_priority: "true"
```
ops-bot: admission-config apply succeeded on eu-west-1 pools a-c; pool-d failed (insufficient capacity)
AJ: autoscaler launched +4 nodes and they're joining pool.
ops-bot: admission_queue_depth 540 -> 95 over 6m
Maria: p95 dropped from ~480ms to ~180ms. p99 still ~880ms but trending down.
Ryan: launching a 10x synthetic to validate worst-case; watching p99 closely.
Zhen: If tails don't normalize we'll rollback the canary kernel on subset and open a postmortem.
AJ: cost note: extra nodes ~ $15/hr. Charging to eng-runtime emergency budget.
Maria: Keep mitigations for 30m, then reassess. Thanks all :thumbsup:
